verdict.rationale: Browser-extension autofill of TOTP codes and passkeys is a fair question for an authenticator app, but the evidence pack never mentions a browser extension or any autofill capability. The nearest items are adjacent conveniences: web/desktop apps, a macOS menu bar mode and type-to-search. The Passkeys mention refers to securing the user's own Ente account, not to filling passkeys into other sites. None of these count toward the story.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a browser extension autofills my TOTP codes and passkeys during login instead of making me retype them
